## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and affected modules.

## Validation evidence

- `make lint`: command/tool versions and result
- `make test`: command/tool versions and result
- `make scan`: command/tool versions and result, including unresolved findings
- Plan or runtime checks, if applicable: account/environment authorization and redacted evidence
- Checks not run and why:

## Impact and review

Describe resource replacement, security, cost and compatibility implications. Link relevant issues and real review evidence when available. Do not include secrets, Terraform state or unredacted plans.
